name: Scryer's Tower
completeE: Place the Scryer's Tower Building on any Flat Tile. Gain 1 Influence for each adjacent Cave or Crystal Building (Pendantmaker, Apothecary, Hippodrome)
visitE: The next time you take any kind of event card, draw +1 Event and choose from between all drawn Events.

name: Fishing Spot
completeE: Place the Fishing Spot Building on a Lake. Gain 1 influence per each adjacent floodplain. Once placed, it is possible to traverse over the lake.
visitE: Roll 1d6. If you get a 5 or a 6, you have caught a fish! Gain 1 influence.

name: Portal Circle
completeE: Place two Portal Circle Tiles anywhere on the board. You may move to one of the two portal tiles.
visitE: Instantly teleport to the other Portal Circle without expending any Movement.

name: Nature's Gazebo
completeE: Place the Nature's Gazebo Tile anywhere on the board.  Roll 1d6 to determine the orientation of the Tile. (The number you roll should be farthest from you.)
visitE: You may pay the number of Resources oriented away from you to gain the number of Resource oriented towards you. Re-Orient.
